description: A `@Directive` without template that changes the look or behavior of its host element.
Object in `@Component`/`@Directive` that declares host bindings (`'[class.x]'`, `'[style.color]'`, `'[attr.role]'`) and listeners (`'(click)'`).
Legacy decorators for host bindings and listeners; still supported, but `host` is preferred.
Applies directives to a component's host element, exposing selected inputs/outputs (with optional aliases).
Wrapper around the host DOM element; use sparingly for imperative APIs.
